cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(vehicle_interface)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)

rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  "msg/VehicleCommand.msg"
  "msg/VehicleFeedback.msg"
)

add_executable(vehicle_interface_node
  src/main.cpp
  src/Vehicle_Interface_Node.cpp
  src/Uart_drv.cpp
)

target_include_directories(vehicle_interface_node PRIVATE
  include
)

ament_target_dependencies(vehicle_interface_node
  rclcpp
)

# Because this executable uses messages generated by THIS SAME package
rosidl_get_typesupport_target(
  cpp_typesupport_target
  ${PROJECT_NAME}
  "rosidl_typesupport_cpp"
)

target_link_libraries(vehicle_interface_node
  "${cpp_typesupport_target}"
)

install(TARGETS
  vehicle_interface_node
  DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME}
)

ament_export_dependencies(rosidl_default_runtime)

ament_package()
